_note: Written 2026-09-29 BEFORE retrieval was implemented. Kept outside vault/ so the harness can never retrieve the answer key.

tests.title: Direct question, one source
tests.question: What mean evaluation score did the trained Ms. Pac-Man agent get, and what did the untrained baseline get?
tests.expected_behavior: Answer 1032.0 for the trained agent vs 492.0 for the untrained baseline (+540), cited to the Pac-Man README.
tests.expected_passage: | Mean score over the five evaluation games | 492.0 | **1032.0** |  (intro table; repeated in the per-seed table: **Mean** | **492.0** | **1032.0** | **+540.0**)

tests.title: Answerable, phrased differently from the source
tests.question: Why can't one person using my networking app see someone else's saved contacts?
tests.expected_behavior: Explain Postgres Row Level Security: every policy on the contacts table checks auth.user_id() = user_id, where auth.user_id() comes from the signed-in user's JWT. The source never uses the words 'person' or 'someone else'.
tests.expected_passage: ## Authentication & Row Level Security -- 'every policy on `contacts` reduces to one predicate — `auth.user_id() = user_id`'

tests.title: Answer connects two sources
tests.question: Which compute device did I train the Pac-Man agent and the nanoGPT models on, and how long did the training take for each?
tests.expected_behavior: Pac-Man: Apple M1 Pro with the PyTorch MPS backend, ~73 minutes (4,388 s) for 800 episodes. nanoGPT: same M1 Pro but DEVICE="cpu", training loop 16.6 s (starter) and 18.7 s (expanded). Each claim cited to its own README.
tests.expected_passage: Pac-Man 'What the run actually cost' table (Elapsed time 4,388 seconds, Hardware ... PyTorch MPS backend); nanoGPT '## The runs' table (Training-loop time 16.6 s / 18.7 s) and 'DEVICE="cpu" as in the course notebook'

tests.title: Plausible but unanswerable
tests.question: What grade did I receive for the Ms. Pac-Man DQN assignment?
tests.expected_behavior: Explicit insufficient-evidence response. The README describes the submission and results but never states a grade. Retrieval will likely return Pac-Man passages; the model must not turn the score (1032) into a grade.
